# Design System Master File — Reconcile

> **LOGIC:** When building a specific page, first check `design-system/reconcile/pages/[page-name].md`.
> If that file exists, its rules **override** this Master file. If not, follow the rules below.

**Project:** Reconcile
**Source:** generated by the ui-ux-pro-max skill (query: "small business invoicing payments fintech trustworthy",
variance 5, motion 4, density 7) on 2026-10-05, then hand-edited. The edits are recorded in `docs/DECISIONS.md` (D-08).
**Style:** Minimalism & Swiss Style — clean, grid-based, high contrast, sans-serif, functional.
**Mood:** financial, trustworthy, precise. The product is a tool for accountants, not a marketing toy.

---

## 1. Colour

Why the generated palette was replaced: it used gold (`#F59E0B`) as primary, which is the same hue as the
`part_paid` status badge, and a purple accent, which the skill's own anti-pattern list forbids.
**Brand (D-62):** navy ink on white with a **teal** brand colour for actions, focus, charts and soft washes.
Teal is a different hue from every status colour below, so status still carries meaning on its own.

### Status colours (one `StatusBadge` component, see frontend/CLAUDE.md)
Badges use a tinted background with darker text, so the text passes 4.5:1 contrast. The dot uses the mid shade.
Every badge also shows its word ("Paid", "Overdue"), so colour is never the only signal.

| Status | Light: bg / text / dot | Dark: bg / text / dot |
|--------|------------------------|-----------------------|
| paid | green-50 / green-700 / green-600 | green-500/15 / green-400 / green-400 |
| part_paid | amber-50 / amber-800 / amber-500 | amber-500/15 / amber-300 / amber-400 |
| overdue | red-50 / red-700 / red-600 | red-500/15 / red-400 / red-400 |
| sent | blue-50 / blue-700 / blue-600 | blue-500/15 / blue-400 / blue-400 |
| draft | slate-100 / slate-600 / slate-400 | slate-500/15 / slate-400 / slate-500 |
| void | slate-100 / slate-500, text struck through | slate-500/15 / slate-500 |

Transaction kinds use the same rule: `settlement` = slate badge "Settlement" (never matched), unmatched credit = amber "Needs review".

## 2. Typography

- **UI font:** IBM Plex Sans (400, 500, 600). Load with `next/font/google`, not a CSS `@import` (no layout shift, self-hosted).
- **Mono font:** IBM Plex Mono (400, 500) for raw bank narrations, references, fingerprints and invoice numbers.
- **Money:** always `tabular-nums`, right-aligned in tables, formatted only by `lib/money.ts` (`₦1,234,500.00`).
- Scale: 12 (labels/meta, uppercase tracking-wide), 14 (table body, default app text), 16 (form inputs, public pages),
  20 (section titles), 24 (page titles), 30–36 (KPI numbers, landing headings). Line height 1.5 for body text.
- Never go below 12px. Inputs are 16px so phones don't zoom on focus.

## 3. Spacing, radius, shadow

Spacing follows Tailwind's 4px scale. Density by area:
- App screens (tables, queue): compact. Table rows 40px, cell padding `px-3 py-2`, card padding `p-4`/`p-5`.
- Marketing and public invoice: spacious. Section padding `py-16`–`py-24`, card padding `p-6`/`p-8`.

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| radius | `0.5rem` (8px) | buttons, inputs, cards; badges are `rounded-full` |
| shadow-sm | `0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.05)` | cards (light theme only; dark uses borders) |
| shadow-lg | `0 10px 15px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08)` | popovers, dialogs, command menu |

Swiss rule: separate things with **borders and whitespace first**, shadows second. Gradients only as a soft
teal wash (`from-brand-soft`) behind headers and hero areas, and the landing page's closing teal band (D-62).

## 4. Components (map to shadcn/ui — never hand-roll an equivalent)

| Need | shadcn component | Notes |
|------|------------------|-------|
| Buttons | `button` | variants: default (navy), outline, ghost, destructive. 36px tall in app, 44px on public/mobile |
| Tables | `table` (+ TanStack for sorting) | sticky header, zebra off, row hover `bg-muted/50`, money right-aligned |
| Status | custom `StatusBadge` built on `badge` | the only place status colours live |
| Forms | `form`, `input`, `select`, `label` | visible labels above fields, error text under the field |
| Dialogs | `dialog`, `alert-dialog` | alert-dialog for reverse allocation (it needs a reason) |
| Feedback | `sonner` toasts | success after accept/allocate; errors explain what to do next |
| Navigation | `sidebar` | Dashboard, Invoices, Customers, Statements, Queue (count badge), Audit |
| Loading | `skeleton` | reserve the final size so nothing jumps |
| Shortcuts | `command` | ⌘K / Ctrl+K jump to invoice or customer |

Icons: **Lucide** only (ships with shadcn), 16px in tables, 20px in nav. No emoji as icons.

## 5. Motion

- Durations 150–400ms (Overview count-up 800ms), `ease-out` for enter, slightly faster for exit.
- Allowed: fade/slide-in of toasts and dialogs, row fade-out when a queue item is resolved, skeleton shimmer, and
  (D-62, utilities in `app/globals.css`): `.animate-rise` (fade + 8px slide up, stagger with `--i`), table rows
  fading in 35ms apart, `.animate-grow` (bars fill from the left), `.animate-pop` (success ticks, no overshoot),
  `.hover-lift` (2px lift + shadow on linked cards; transform, so neighbours don't move), a pulsing dot on
  overdue badges, and KPI figures counting up in whole kobo to the exact value (`lib/use-count-up.ts`).
- **Not allowed:** `back.out` overshoot or scale bounce on tables and numbers (the skill itself warns this reads as sloppy
  on data UI), hover transforms that shift layout, GSAP. CSS transitions and `tailwindcss-animate` are enough.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`: use the `motion-safe:` prefix for anything that moves.

## 6. Charts (Recharts)

Before writing chart code, load the `dataviz` skill. Defaults: navy series in light theme / slate-200 in dark,
status colours only when the series *is* a status (e.g. ageing buckets → overdue red). Always a tooltip with ₦ values,
axis labels in 12px muted text, no 3D, no pie charts with more than 4 slices.

## 7. Page pattern — landing

Hero (one-line promise + a real-looking reconciliation card as the visual) > How it works (3 steps: upload statement,
auto-match, review exceptions) > Trust (kobo-exact maths, duplicate-safe imports, full audit trail) > CTA "Create free workspace".
Generated pattern said "Contact Sales"; replaced because the users are SMEs who sign up themselves.

## 8. Anti-patterns (do NOT use)

- Playful design, illustrations of cartoon people, AI purple/pink gradients
- Colour as the only signal of status
- Emoji as icons; icon-only buttons without an `aria-label`
- Floats or rounded numbers in the UI (show full kobo precision: `₦90,000.00`)
- Layout-shifting hovers, instant state changes, invisible focus rings
- Placeholder-only labels

## 9. Pre-delivery checklist

- [ ] Light and dark themes both pass 4.5:1 for text (check muted text and badges)
- [ ] Focus ring visible on every interactive element (Tab through the page)
- [ ] `cursor-pointer` on clickable rows and buttons
- [ ] Money right-aligned, `tabular-nums`, formatted by `formatNaira`
- [ ] Narrations in Plex Mono
- [ ] Responsive at 375, 768, 1024, 1440px; no horizontal page scroll (tables scroll inside their own container)
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` respected
- [ ] Empty, loading and error states designed for every list
